business_overview.one_sentence: The Group mainly provides comprehensive flexible staffing services and professional recruitment and other HR solutions in China.

segments.business_substance: Flexible staffing services, including general service outsourcing, digital technology and cloud services, and digital operation and customer services.
segments.source: Annual Report 2024, Management Discussion and Analysis, revenue by business segment, p.16

segments.item: Professional recruitment and other HR solutions
segments.business_substance: Professional recruitment, labour dispatch, training and consultation services.
segments.source: Annual Report 2024, Management Discussion and Analysis, revenue by business segment, p.16-p.18

business_overview.revenue_model: Revenue is mainly service revenue from comprehensive flexible staffing; the company pays labour and subcontracting costs and grants customer credit periods, especially around 90 days and up to about 150 days for some digital technology and cloud service clients.
business_notes: Comprehensive flexible staffing contributed 99.1% of 2024 revenue.
Top five clients contributed 35.0% of 2024 revenue and the largest client contributed 11.3%.
Trade receivables, contract assets and notes receivables turnover days increased to 102 days in 2024 from 93 days in 2023.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Impairment loss on goodwill allocated to Shanghai Sirui CGU.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2024, MDA Other Losses and Note 18, p.20 and p.216

non_recurring_items.item: Adjusted profit attributable to equity holders
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Non-HKFRS adjusted profit excluding share-based payment, acquired intangible amortisation, goodwill impairment, fair value gains/losses on equity investments and tax/NCI effects.

funds_assets.business_substance: Unrestricted cash and bank balances after deducting restricted cash.
Deposits held at banks in relation to bank borrowings and bank guarantees for operational qualification certificates.

funds_assets.item: Current financial assets at fair value through profit or loss
funds_assets.business_substance: Investment-grade bond funds purchased with idle funds.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2024, Balance Sheet p.146 and MDA p.25

operating_assets.item: Trade receivables, contract assets and notes receivables
operating_assets.business_substance: Customer receivables and contract assets from HR service revenue; turnover days 102 days in 2024.
operating_assets.source: Annual Report 2024, Balance Sheet p.146, MDA p.23-p.24 and Note 22 p.223

operating_assets.business_substance: Right-of-use assets for offices, renovation, computer equipment and furniture.
operating_assets.source: Annual Report 2024, Balance Sheet p.146 and Note 17 p.215

investment_assets.business_substance: Equity-accounted joint ventures, mainly Xunteng Group.
investment_assets.source: Annual Report 2024, Balance Sheet p.146 and Note 13 p.203

investment_assets.item: Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss - non-current
investment_assets.business_substance: Non-listed equity investments in Shanghai Kumao and Greedy Technology with preferential rights.
investment_assets.source: Annual Report 2024, Balance Sheet p.146 and Note 13 p.204

other_assets.business_substance: Goodwill and customer relationships from acquisitions plus software.
other_assets.source: Annual Report 2024, Balance Sheet p.146 and Note 18 p.216

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Bank borrowings maturing within one year; includes secured bank borrowings by bank deposits and/or receivables and unsecured borrowings.
Lease liabilities for leased properties; treated as operating-required leases in owner earnback analysis rather than cash debt deduction.

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Mainly accrued payroll and welfare, VAT and surcharges, customer risk deposits and other payables.
operating_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2024, Balance Sheet p.147 and Note 27 p.227

other_liabilities.business_substance: Put option/redemption liabilities to non-controlling interests.
other_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2024, Balance Sheet p.147 and Statement of Changes in Equity p.149

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Reported profit is distorted by goodwill impairment, but even adjusted profit is weakly cash backed: 2023 and 2024 operating cash flow were both negative as receivables and contract assets expanded.

evidence.source: Annual Report 2024, Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows, p.150

gaps: Annual report does not split cash between listed parent, offshore subsidiaries, PRC subsidiaries and other controlled entities.
Annual report does not provide a precise minimum operating cash requirement.
Only 2023 and 2024 cash flow details were extracted from the current annual report; 2022 cash flow was not extracted from a separate filing.
